title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
ii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iii.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
iv.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
v.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
colophon: drift and pull; a field that never settles the same way twice.
